newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mixed in slow trading.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mixed in sluggish activity as most buyers were engaged in hand-to-mouth purchases to cover nearby needs, dealers said.
"Nearby demand is definitely better," a Missouri dealer said. He noted a slight increase in the feed business, especially in Oklahoma, Arkansas, Missouri and Texas.

There is steady demand, but there is a little hesitancy, a Minneapolis broker said. Some of the feed mixers were not buying because they were probably covered with previously-purchased inventory, he added.
In the Carolinas, spot values rose $5 a ton to bid at $95 and offer at $107.00.
"They are scrambling trying to buy mids" due to smaller nearby supplies in the northeast.
Some of the mills in the northeast, like Buffalo, were running a little bit less which has made some of the sellers come down to the south to cover that shortage, he said.
